scenario_context.text: A user attempts a full withdrawal of their deposit.
The full withdrawal deterministically reverts with PANIC(0x11) arithmetic underflow.
The user is permanently blocked from fully closing their position, trapping their funds when liquidating assets.

items.claim: OffsetProgressiveCurve was initialized with an offset18 parameter smaller than 1e9.

evidence.text: In OffsetProgressiveCurve.sol, an arithmetic underflow ensures users cannot withdraw their full deposit if the curve was initialized with an offset18 parameter smaller than 1e9.

Any OffsetProgressiveCurve instantiated with offset18 < 1e9 collapses in mathematically equivalent conditions to ProgressiveCurve. Users will be permanently blocked from fully closing their positions, causing trapped funds whenever liquidating assets.

items.claim: During initialize, OFFSET = PCMath.divDown(OFFSET18, 1e18) truncates to 0 because OFFSET18 < 1e18, so the stored OFFSET is 0 before the withdrawal.

evidence.text: When initialize stores the OFFSET18 parameter, it calculates the raw parameter OFFSET = PCMath.divDown(OFFSET18, 1e18). If OFFSET18 is less than 1e18, OFFSET strictly evaluates to 0. During deposit and withdrawal calculations, this truncated OFFSET influences internal rounding mechanics differently than ProgressiveCurve.
